declaration: Additional prospective check approved before the one full-r3 simulator launch; companion to full_launch.json
required_check: Original time plus60 numeric columns on0–0.85us must have exact decoded byte parity against passed direct-r2 prefix, including formatting, spacing and newline. Only the new actual-hard-clock column is projected away. Numeric and exact time-grid checks remain separately required.
failure_policy: Any byte/numeric/time-grid parity failure remains failed even if later mechanism observations look correct.
